title: Israel election results live: Qatar says accusations of election interference in Israel ‘ridiculous and dangerous’
summary_full: Netanyahu’s claim of interference in election also dismissed by Israeli police and opposition partiesIsrael’s choice: Netanyahu remaining in power or a Palestinian-backed coalitionGadi Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party and Benjamin Netanyahu’s main rival, has warned political opponents against exploiting allegations of foreign interference in Israel’s election to delay the swearing-in of the next Knesset.In remarks posted on X, Eisenkot said:Israel must safeguard the integrity of the elections against any attempt at interference, spin and manipulation, and examine every complaint thoroughly. On the other hand, political actors must not be allowed to exploit the situation and affect the swearing-in date of the 26th Knesset.” Continue reading...
